name: Jobber

tiers.how: Sage connects to Jobber via the official Jobber GraphQL API (OAuth 2.0) at developer.getjobber.com. The owner must create a Jobber App in the developer portal, complete the OAuth consent flow, and store the refresh token via setup_creds. Token refresh is automatic. Reads are free; writes require approval.
always_tap: any invoice send to a client
any job dispatch to a team member

gotchas: Jobber's GraphQL API requires all query fields to be specified explicitly; there are no wildcard selectors.
OAuth refresh tokens expire; implement token rotation with a refresh-before-expiry strategy.
Jobber is designed for field-service businesses; some CRM and marketing features are less developed than in a general-purpose CRM.
Jobber's developer portal and API documentation are at developer.getjobber.com.
notes: Jobber is a field-service management platform with strong scheduling and dispatch features; well-suited to trades and home-service businesses.
